title: OPM Fires Privacy Officials After CNN FOIA Request About DOGE Clearances
description_medium: In February 2025, CNN requested records from the Office of Personnel Management about security clearances for Elon Musk and Department of Government Efficiency personnel. An OPM email replied, “Good luck with that, they just fired the whole privacy team.” CNN then reported that multiple privacy-office employees and other officials had been dismissed. An OPM spokesperson disputed that the entire privacy team had been laid off. The event raised concerns about privacy oversight and access to records, but the email itself did not change the agency’s legal duties under FOIA.
description_long: The Office of Personnel Management dismissed multiple privacy officials and other employees in early 2025, CNN reported after filing a Freedom of Information Act request for records about Elon Musk’s security clearance and DOGE personnel with access to sensitive government networks. An email response from an OPM address told CNN, “Good luck with that, they just fired the whole privacy team.” The message brought attention to the staffing changes because OPM’s privacy staff oversee agency data-protection practices. An OPM official told CNN that the agency had not laid off the entire privacy team, though the official did not provide further detail. CNN’s request sought records about security clearances and DOGE-linked access to government networks. The dispute focused on how many privacy staff members had been dismissed and what capacity remained to handle privacy and records responsibilities. The episode illustrated how staffing cuts and unanswered information requests can create uncertainty about oversight of access to government systems, while agencies remain subject to statutory disclosure requirements.
source_access_notes: Reviewed CNN report reprinted by ABC17: https://abc17news.com/politics/national-politics/cnn-us-politics/2025/02/18/good-luck-with-that-trump-administration-terminates-privacy-officials-at-agency-overseeing-government-hiring-and-firing/.
